description: Opens a global library file (.alNN on the serve host, e.g. MyLib.al21 — the file inside the library folder) in the TIA Portal session and returns its name; readWrite defaults to true (pass false to open it read-only). Serves after app 1.6.3 refuse an unusable path before TIA, nothing opened: a missing file is 404 kind:"not_found"; a folder, a file that is not .alNN or a malformed path (e.g. with quotes) is 400 kind:"bad_request" (up to 1.6.3: 500 internal). Maps to POST /globallibraries/open {path, readWrite}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

path.description: library file path on the serve host

name: tia_global_library_open
